name: keybox
description: A printed caps key, then its value: every date the product shows, and the price. The value is handwritten (the date, written in as the page arrives) or printed (a label or a price). On a pushed page with no wordmark the date box names the page and its value is the h1.

date.description: hand: the value is the date written by hand, which writes itself in on arrival. printed: a label or a price in print (data-printed on the value, set in --f-prose and --t-field, never written in; was .v.printed). Contexts read it (the glance waits for a hand date).

noRule.hand: the hand is the value's base style and its write-in is keyed on the absence of data-printed; data-date="hand" is the context mark the glance's date wait reads

valueTag.description: h1 when the date box names the page (a past day, an answer).

key.description: The key, final copy ("Day", "Keeping", "Account"), set in printed caps.

exposes.--aj-c-keybox-value-size: The value's size (--t-hand-l); the compact recorder sets 22px below 620.

states.default: yes: as rendered, a handwritten value writes itself in on arrival (C3 motion, --g-date)
states.loading: n/a: a date is known before the page draws
states.empty: n/a: key and value are required

a11y.role: none: text; the value is the page's h1 when valueTag is h1
a11y.labels: the key labels the value visually; both are read in order

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css D1 (.keybox, .k, .v, .v.printed), its write-in motion and its masthead, auth and recorder contexts.
Variant date (data-date) and the date hook on the value.
One way to say hand or print: the date variant (the printed option is gone); its default, printed, is the render's too.

hooks.date: The value a masthead shows as its date; the runtime reads it.
